name: zvideo_dd_clear_sw_backbuffer_and_zbuffer_rects
description: zVideo_dd::ClearSwBackbufferAndZBufferRects conditionally clears the software backbuffer rectangle, then clears a separate Z-buffer rectangle with provider Restore retry handling.
